text.en:
The following items under section one, paragraph (d), subsection A of Commonwealth Act
Numbered Sixty-seven, as amended, are further amended so as to read as follows:
"26. For an additional room for the San Jose Central School
?2,000.00
"13. For the Maka barrio school, Lucban"
1,500.00"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, August 23, 1938.
